title: Markdown Editor
description: Split-pane markdown editor with live preview. PM defines requirements, UI designs layout, Frontend implements editor+preview.
userPrompt: 帮我做一个 Markdown 编辑器。React，左边编辑区，右边实时预览。支持标题、列表、代码块、链接、图片语法。暗色主题，可以本地保存草稿。
successCriteria: UI reads PRD and creates style guide
Frontend reads PRD and style guide
Frontend creates web_app artifact with split-pane layout
Live preview updates as user types
